subject: Linguistics
title: Verb Phrases
description: A short lesson to help you apply Verb Phrases.

hook.text: 'Has been quietly reading a book' is one big verb phrase—the verb 'reading' is its core.

buildup.text: A verb phrase contains the main verb plus its objects, complements, and adverbs.

discovery.text: Auxiliaries ('has,' 'been') build up around the main verb in a fixed order.

twist.text: English stacks up to four auxiliaries: 'might have been being watched.'

climax.text: The VP is the engine of the sentence—it tells you what happened and to whom.

punchline.text: Pile on helpers—the main verb still drives.

quiz.question: What does a verb phrase contain?
options: Main verb plus objects and complements
